subject: Proposal: phased GPU ramp + tiered discount for Q4 renewal
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@atlasai.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scaling plan and pricing for Dedicated GPUs

Hi Aisha,

Quick note from our capacity planning session: we expect a material increase in inference volume starting Oct 1 and are exploring two paths — burst credits vs. adding reserved GPUs to our Dedicated pool. We currently run a 16-GPU pool and expect demand to double by December if the new feature lands as planned.

Questions:
- Can you share a pricing comparison for a mid-contract uplift to +16 GPUs (i.e., going from 16 -> 32) vs. using burst?
- Do you offer a phased ramping option (e.g., +8 now, +8 in 3 months) with an associated tiered discount?
- Any throughput guarantees (tokens/s or p99 latency) you can commit to for reserved pools vs. burst?

We have a renewal conversation in Aug and want to include the right financials. If you can send a starter quote and recommended structure I can take it to finance and ops.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
VP Engineering, AtlasAI
sanajy@atlasai.com

P.S. attaching our Jan-Jun 2026 usage CSV (ops asked for it) — happy to send more detail if useful.

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@atlasai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling plan and pricing for Dedicated GPUs

Sanjay — thanks for the clear ask and the CSV. We can absolutely support a phased uplift and have two well-used patterns:

1) Phased reserve add (recommended for predictable throughput)
   - Tranche A: +8 GPUs (immediate) — 12% uplift discount on list rate for the first 3 months
   - Tranche B: +8 GPUs (automatic onboarding in 90 days) — 8% uplift discount thereafter
   - Billing: pro-rated month of change, full reservation on tranche activation

2) Burst-first (recommended to defer commit risk)
   - Burst credits at a premium; convert to reserved with step-down credits if you commit within 60/120 days

Throughput/SLA: for reserved pools we target throughput SLOs and offer a 99.0% availability commitment for scheduled capacity with a credit structure for unplanned degradation. For mixed burst/reserve patterns we can agree to a throughput baseline for the reserved portion and best-effort for burst. If you need 99.5% we can include that in an addendum with a modest rate adjustment.

I drafted a starter quote and a phased addendum (see attached PDF: redwood_q4_phased_ramp_quote_v3.pdf) showing pricing, expected unit economics, and the rollback/fallback policy. The quote also includes a small onboarding credit for migration and an optional QoS guarantee for the first 30 days after each tranche goes live.

If this looks reasonable I can coordinate with legal to prepare a midterm addendum and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Cheers,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Aisha Rahman | aisha@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_q4_phased_ramp_quote_v3.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: AtlasAI concession ask — pricing math and recommended stance

Karthik / Marissa — looping you in on AtlasAI (deal RDW-2026-0457). Sanjay asked about a phased ramp from 16 -> 32 GPUs mid-contract. I proposed the tiered structure below and attached the starter quote.

Key levers I used:
- Frontload a stronger discount on Tranche A (12%) to get an early commit and signal value.
- Lower discount on Tranche B (8%) because conversion risk is lower once usage ramps.
- Offer onboarding credit (~$10k) to offset migration ops and shorten procurement friction.
- QoS guarantee for 30 days post-tranche to reduce operational risk.

Recommended approval thresholds:
- Approve final concession up to 15% on Tranche A if needed to land commitment this month.
- Do not exceed 10% on Tranche B.
- Approve the SLA addendum at 99.0% without price change; 99.5% requires a +4% uplift on list.

If you both sign off I will send the DocuSign and include an auto-convert clause (burst -> reserved within 90 days) in the addendum. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Aisha

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@atlasai.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@atlasai.com, Ruth Stein <ruth.stein@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: phased GPU ramp + tiered discount for Q4 renewal

Aisha — thank you, the structure looks reasonable and aligns with what finance expects. A couple of asks before we finalize:

1) Can you incorporate a 99.5% throughput commitment for the reserved pool (we're willing to pay the uplift you mentioned) — we need predictability for a latency-sensitive feature.
2) Please add an explicit midterm uplift clause: if our usage exceeds the agreed baseline by >30% for two consecutive months, we auto-trigger Tranche B at the agreed price, with a 30-day notice window to Ops.
3) We'll need a DocuSign-ready addendum and a clear billing schedule (dates and pro-rate examples).

Attached is the Jan-Jun usage CSV I referenced — our ops lead copied here (ops@atlasai.com) if they have operational questions. Can you send the DocuSign and an updated quote with the 99.5% addendum?

Best,
Sanjay

Attachment: atlas_usage_breakdown_JanJun2026.csv (CSV, 120KB)

Sanjay — excellent, thanks for the clear asks. Final next steps below:

1) I'll revise the quote to show the 99.5% throughput addendum and the uplift percentage (+4% on tranche pricing) and attach the updated PDF.
2) I'll include the midterm uplift automation language: Tranche B auto-activates with a 30-day notice if usage >30% baseline for two months. Billing will be pro-rated on activation date; examples will be shown on page 4 of the quote.
3) Legal: I'll route the addendum to our legal team for a quick review and push a DocuSign envelope to your inbox once done (expect within 48 hrs).

Would you like me to hold the initial onboarding credit and the stronger Tranche A discount (up to 15%) for signatures received before Aug 5? We can do that to accelerate procurement.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the updated PDF and DocuSign link.

Regards,
